members.name: value
members.doc: Return of the day in percent: 1.2 means the day closed 1.2% up.

types.name: ReturnsCalendarProps
types.doc: A calendar of daily returns: one small month per card, one cell per trading day, tinted by how much the day gained or lost, with the total of each month beside its name. Months rise in one after another and their cells follow in a wave; a tooltip glides between days with the day and its month to date. Arrow keys walk the days, and a click selects one.

members.name: returns
members.doc: One entry per trading day, in any order. Days without an entry are drawn as closed.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the calendar, such as "Daily returns, first half of 2026".

members.name: period
members.doc: Text beside the overall total. Defaults to the range of months the data covers.

members.name: weekends
members.doc: Shows Saturday and Sunday columns. Off by default, for markets that close on weekends.

members.name: scale
members.doc: Return in percent at which the color saturates. Defaults to a high percentile of the data.

members.name: compound
members.doc: Compounds daily returns into the totals. Set false to add them up instead.

members.name: selectedDate
members.doc: Selected day as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none. Leave undefined to let the calendar keep its own selection.

members.name: defaultSelectedDate
members.doc: Day selected at first when the calendar keeps its own selection.

members.name: onSelectDate
members.doc: Called with the day that was clicked, or null when the selected day is clicked again.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same labels.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
